floor_contrast.reason: the ARENA'S OWN NOISE FLOOR does not differ by context: B-A -0.430 [-1.927, +1.366] grey levels over 30 animals and 150 paired cells, median B-A -1.500. So the A/B image difference does NOT reach the sensor-noise channel, and Q2 is not confounded at that level

floor_contrast_census.reason: the ARENA'S OWN NOISE FLOOR DIFFERS BY CONTEXT: B-A -1.296 [-2.020, -0.505] grey levels over 144 animals and 720 paired cells, median B-A -1.125. This is §7's confound measured on the pixel channel itself, and it runs on exactly the axis Q2 uses

grid_degeneracy.reason: THE REGISTERED HEADLINE ARM CANNOT BE READ: m2_p25_s0.5 is degenerate on 62% of cells, and 0 of the 27 DERIVED arms are defined on every cell (least degenerate eztrack_default at 0%). A degenerate arm drops the QUIETEST recordings, which is selection on the outcome. §4 defined FreezeThresh as a percentile of Motion, but at a cutoff derived from the arena floor Motion carries a large atom at zero and a low percentile of it is zero. The only arm defined everywhere is ezTrack's own absolute threshold, which §9.5 forbids adopting -- it is 4x too strict at this resolution -- so it is reported and never read as the answer
